headline: WHAT HOLDS THE TAIL

forbid: The dial indicator is the episode MOTIF (script header) -- drawn plainly, never explained as a symbol.

headline: ONE CAUSE. THREE CONTRIBUTING.

lines.t: CAUSE: ACME NUT THREAD FAILURE FROM EXCESSIVE WEAR — INSUFFICIENT LUBRICATION
THE EXTENDED LUBRICATION INTERVAL — AND THE FAA'S APPROVAL OF IT
THE EXTENDED END PLAY CHECK INTERVAL — AND THE FAA'S APPROVAL OF IT
NO FAIL-SAFE ON THE MD-80 FOR TOTAL THREAD LOSS

forbid: All four lines compress VERBATIM Board findings (AK-101..104). Compression may not shift blame beyond the Board's own wording.
